subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Recovery Principle
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Recovery Principle usable.

hook.text: Elite athletes train hard, then rest deliberately. High performers at work train hard, then feel guilty for resting.

buildup.text: Muscle grows during rest, not during exercise. Cognitive capacity follows the same pattern.

discovery.text: Deliberate recovery means activities that genuinely restore: nature, social connection, play, or complete idleness.

twist.text: Watching Netflix while checking work email is not recovery. Partial attention prevents genuine restoration.

climax.text: Schedule recovery like you schedule meetings. Block it, protect it, and stop apologizing for it.

punchline.text: Rest is not the opposite of work. It's the fuel.

quiz.question: Why is deliberate recovery important for sustained productivity?
options: It satisfies social expectations about work-life balance
Cognitive capacity restores during genuine rest, not partial attention
It only matters for physical laborers
